name: Output Rate and Time
description: Calculate total output produced from a constant rate applied over a period of time.
business_contexts: a factory calculating total output from a production line's hourly rate
a call center calculating total calls handled from an hourly rate
a warehouse calculating total units picked from an hourly rate
a bottler calculating total cases filled from an hourly rate
a print shop calculating total pages printed from an hourly rate
question_patterns: Given the rate and time below, what is total output?
Calculate total output from the rate and time figures given.
What is the total output produced, given the rate and time shown?
Calculate output by multiplying the rate and time given.
Using the rate and time below, what is total output?
solution_logic: Step 1: Calculate total output = rate × time
key_insight: Output scales linearly with time at a constant rate — the moment the rate itself changes partway through, this formula stops applying and the period has to be split.
common_mistakes: Dividing rate by time instead of multiplying
Using a daily or weekly time figure when the rate is expressed per hour
framework_soundbite: Output is rate times time — a constant rate held over a period, nothing more.
display_context: Core Arithmetic • Output Rate and Time
